content.title: Recalls
content.text: Electrolux Group Recalls Frigidaire Gas Ranges Due to Burn HazardThe ovens in the ranges can experience a delayed ignition of the oven's bake burner, posing a risk of burn hazards to users.Issued March 19, 2026 View Recall Midea recalls Window Air Conditioners Due to Risk of Mold ExposurePoor drainage in air conditioners can cause mold, posing respiratory or infection risks to some consumers.Issued June 5, 2025 View Recall Samsung Recalls Slide-In Electric Ranges Due to Fire HazardFront-mounted knobs on the ranges can be activated by accidental contact by humans or pets, posing a fire hazard.Issued August 8, 2024 View Recall Prime-Line Glass DoorknobsRecall due to potential cracking leading to a laceration hazard.Issued August 31, 2023 View Recall Frigidaire Stainless-Steel 30-inch 4 Burner and 36-inch 5 Burner Gas CooktopsRecall due to risk of gas leak.Issued August 31, 2023 View Recall Fabuloso All-Purpose CleanerRecall due to risk of exposure to bacteria.Issued February 8, 2023 View Recall DeWalt 12-inch Sliding Compound Miter SawsRecall due to rear safety guard can break or detachIssued August 4, 2022 View Recall Frigidaire Appliances- Side-by-side, Top Freezer and Multi-door refrigeratorsRecall due to choking hazard from ice makerIssued June 2, 2022 View Recall G.E. Appliances- Free-Standing French Door RefrigeratorsRecall due to fall hazard.Issued April 14, 2022 View Recall G.E.
